visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a woman with long dark hair holding her hair back to display her scalp. She has neutral makeup and is wearing a white top. The background is a plain indoor wall. Yellow and white text appears at the top. (2) A rapid montage follows, showing the woman in different settings: wearing sunglasses by a pool in a white bikini, and then celebrating a birthday with purple balloons. A wooden hairbrush filled with shed hair is shown in a close-up against a dark background. (3) The woman enters a living room with a beige sofa, carrying a large designer tote bag. She looks exhausted and flops onto the sofa. Later, she is in bed, illuminated by her smartphone screen in the dark, touching her hairline with concern in front of a mirror. (4) Standing in a well-lit indoor room, the woman holds a large dark brown shampoo bottle and two smaller essence bottles. She wears a pink and white textured vest. Digital graphics showing a single hair strand and a drop of liquid appear on screen to illustrate product benefits. (5) The woman demonstrates the product. She sprays an orange-labeled bottle onto her scalp and massages it with her fingers. She repeats this with a green-labeled bottle. Close-ups show her massaging the hairline area thoroughly. The lighting is bright and even across the indoor setting. (6) The woman smiles at the camera, tossing her long, voluminous hair from side to side to show the result. Small sparkling graphic effects are added around her head. The video ends with a close-up of her smiling face as pinkish-purple light filters through the frame.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: An Asian woman with long, straight black hair. She wears various outfits including a white bikini, a blue dress, and a pink patterned vest.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A home environment with a beige sofa and bed. One scene shows an outdoor pool area with green trees. A bathroom mirror is used for the application demonstration.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy electronic pop BGM with a steady beat starts immediately. A female voice speaks in an excited tone with clear articulation. A sharp whoosh sound effect marks the transition from the scalp introduction to the hair density comparison shot. (2) The narrator's tone shifts to a more rhythmic delivery while describing hair loss problems. The BGM tempo remains consistent. A soft thud sound occurs as the hairbrush appears, followed by a ding sound effect as the three-month result is emphasized. (3) The voice becomes professional and informative as she mentions the brand MUTTA. The BGM maintains its upbeat tempo. A pop sound effect accompanies the appearance of sparkling graphics. There is a slight pause in speech before she starts explaining product ingredients. (4) A mechanical click sound effect triggers as she holds the essence bottles. The narrator's voice has high pitch variability, emphasizing the 98 percent figure. The ambient noise is minimal, suggesting a quiet recording. The BGM beat remains prominent throughout. (5) A distinct spray or spritz sound effect is heard as the narrator provides instructions on how to use the essence. Her voice is friendly and instructional. The spectral brightness is high, emphasizing the crispness of the sound effects and the voice. (6) The music swells slightly as the narrator reaches a concluding, enthusiastic tone. A final sparkle sound effect plays as the visual shows the voluminous hair results. The audio concludes with a final upbeat musical flourish and a warm closing sentiment.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem -> Solution -> Demo -> Result -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote hair care products from the brand MUTTA by demonstrating their effectiveness in treating thinning hair and hair loss. It uses a relatable personal narrative of feeling stressed and seeing hair fall, then provides a scientific-sounding solution and clear usage instructions to build trust and encourage a purchase.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator directly shows the products, mentions the brand name multiple times, explains the ingredients, and demonstrates the application process.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes high-density text overlays and upbeat music to maintain viewer attention. The use of 'Before/After' visuals is a key persuasive element.
